alt_text: Session-level FSI distributions are shown by canonical cohort with sample counts, quality, and component coverage. Missing scores are not plotted.
interpretation: FSI distributions provide multivariate context after primary measurements and are not pain, diagnosis, or causal scores.
limitations: Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
